    • 蝶式差价 (分别利用看涨期权和看跌期权)

第 3 页 · 到期损益与净利润幻灯片 ↗

期权与标的资产的头寸组合

  • 将期权与其标的资产进行组合：
    • 期权头寸可以与标的股票的多头或空头头寸相结合，从而改变投资组合的风险-收益特征。
  • 主要经典策略：
    • 备兑看涨期权 (Covered Call)：
      • 为持有标的资产的投资者提供一定的下行缓冲/保护。
      • 在平稳或温和上涨的市场环境中获取期权费权利金收益。
    • 保护性看跌期权 (Protective Put)：
      • 提供明确且有保证的短期下行保护（充当投资组合保险）。
      • 若标的资产大幅飙升，仍能完全保留无限的上方盈利潜力。
Page 3 · Payoff vs ProfitSlide ↗

Positions in Options and Underlying Assets

  • Combining options with their underlying assets:
    • Option positions can be combined with long or short positions in the underlying stock to alter the portfolio's risk-return profile.
  • Primary Examples:
    • Covered Call:
      • Provides downside buffer / protection to investors holding the underlying asset.
      • Generates premium income in a stable or mildly bullish market.
    • Protective Put:
      • Provides guaranteed short-term downside protection (acts as portfolio insurance).
      • Preserves unlimited upside profit potential if the underlying asset rallies.
第 4 页 · 备兑看涨期权幻灯片 ↗

备兑看涨期权 (Covered Call)

  • 卖出备兑看涨期权 (Writing a covered call)：
    • 持有资产多头并卖出看涨期权空头：S0−c
    • 到期损益形态与卖出看跌期权同构：
      由买卖权平价定理：c+Ke−rT=p+S0
      移项可得：
      S0−c=−p+Ke−rT
  • 反向备兑看涨期权 (Reverse of writing a covered call)：
    • 持有股票空头并买入看涨期权多头：−S0+c
    • 到期损益形态与买入看跌期权同构：
      −S0+c=p−Ke−rT
Page 4 · Covered CallsSlide ↗

Covered Call

  • Writing a covered call:
    • Long position in the asset and short position in the call option: S0−c
    • Final payoff profile is isomorphic to a short put:
      From put-call parity: c+Ke−rT=p+S0
      Rearranging:
      S0−c=−p+Ke−rT
  • Reverse of writing a covered call:
    • Short position in the stock and long position in the call option: −S0+c
    • Final payoff profile is isomorphic to a long put:
      −S0+c=p−Ke−rT

ST≥50 ST−48 50−ST +1 +3

ST≥50 ST−48 50−ST +1 +3
第 6 页 · 备兑看涨期权幻灯片 ↗

备兑看涨期权：策略属性

  • 适用市场环境：市场走势平稳中性或温和看涨。
  • 策略优势：
    • 在买入股票的同时卖出看涨期权，可以降低股票的净购入成本。
    • 对已持有的股票卖出看涨期权，可带来持续的期权费权利金现金流；若股价下跌，该期权费可提供一定的下行缓冲垫。
    • 持有标的股票可以完全对冲股价暴涨带来的损失风险（避免了裸卖空看涨期权的无限风险）。
  • 盈亏平衡点：S0−c=$48−$1=$47。
  • 策略特性：
    • 在牛市行情中，虚值备兑看涨期权 (OTM) 具有最高的盈利潜力。
    • 在平稳行情或轻度熊市行情中，实值备兑看涨期权 (ITM) 能够提供最充裕的期权费安全垫。
  • 面临问题 / 权衡取舍：上方盈利潜力被严格封顶（上限为 K−S0+c=$3），而若股价大幅暴跌，依然面临显著的下行亏损风险（最大亏损可达 −S0+c=−$47）。
Page 6 · Covered CallsSlide ↗

Covered Call: Strategy Properties

  • Market profile: Neutral market or mildly bullish market.
  • Benefits:
    • When buying shares, shorting call options simultaneously reduces the net purchase cost.
    • Writing calls against shares you already own generates regular premium income; the income provides downside cushion if the stock declines.
    • Owning the shares provides complete protection against large losses if the stock surges (avoids naked call risk).
  • Breakeven point: S0−c=$48−$1=$47.
  • Properties:
    • In a bullish market, OTM covered calls provide the highest profit potential.
    • In a stable/moderately bearish market, ITM covered calls provide the best premium income cushion.
  • Problem / Trade-off: Limited profit potential (capped at K−S0+c=$3) and potentially large downside loss if the stock falls severely (down to −S0+c=−$47).
第 7 页 · 保护性看跌期权幻灯片 ↗

保护性看跌期权 (Protective Put)

  • 保护性看跌期权：
    • 持有资产多头并买入看跌期权多头：S0+p
    • 到期损益形态与买入看涨期权同构：
      由买卖权平价定理：c+Ke−rT=p+S0
      移项可得：
      S0+p=c+Ke−rT
  • 反向保护性看跌期权：
    • 持有资产空头并卖出看跌期权空头：−S0−p
    • 到期损益形态与卖出看涨期权同构：
      −S0−p=−c−Ke−rT
Page 7 · Protective PutsSlide ↗

Protective Put

  • Protective put:
    • Long position in the asset and long position in the put option: S0+p
    • Final payoff profile is isomorphic to a long call:
      From put-call parity: c+Ke−rT=p+S0
      Rearranging:
      S0+p=c+Ke−rT
  • Reverse protective put:
    • Short position in the asset and short position in the put option: −S0−p
    • Final payoff profile is isomorphic to a short call:
      −S0−p=−c−Ke−rT
第 8 页 · 保护性看跌期权幻灯片 ↗

到期价格 ST 股票多头 看跌期权多头 (K=50) 权利金合计 净损益总计
ST<50 ST−48 50−ST −3 −1
ST≥50 ST−48 0 −3 ST−51

ST≥50 ST−48 0 −3 ST−51
第 9 页 · 保护性看跌期权幻灯片 ↗

保护性看跌期权：策略属性

  • 适用市场环境：对标的资产长期看涨，但对短期市场下行风险保持谨慎。
  • 策略优势：投资组合保险 (Portfolio insurance)
    • 严格锁定最大可能亏损：下行亏损被锁定为 S0+p−K=$48+$3−$50=$1。
    • 若股票价格大幅飙升，依然享有完全无限的上方盈利空间。
  • 盈亏平衡点：S0+p=$48+$3=$51。
  • 策略特性：
    • 虚值看跌期权 (OTM) 购买成本较低，但提供的下行保护不及实值看跌期权 (ITM)。
    • 一旦股票价格上涨突破盈亏平衡线，该策略即可实现盈利。
  • 面临问题：需要预先支付现金权利金。看跌期权费相当于保险费，在强劲牛市中会降低投资组合的整体收益率。
Page 9 · Protective PutsSlide ↗

Protective Put: Strategy Properties

  • Market profile: Bullish underlying view, but cautious about downside market risk.
  • Benefits: Portfolio insurance
    • Provides strictly limited loss potential: downside loss is capped at S0+p−K=$48+$3−$50=$1.
    • Provides completely unlimited upside profit potential if the stock surges.
  • Breakeven point: S0+p=$48+$3=$51.
  • Properties:
    • OTM put options are cheaper to buy, but provide less downside protection than ITM put options.
    • The strategy becomes profitable once the stock price rises above the breakeven level.
  • Problem: Requires an upfront cash premium. The put premium acts as an insurance premium that reduces portfolio performance in a bull market.
第 10 页 · 保护性看跌期权幻灯片 ↗

备兑看涨期权 vs 保护性看跌期权：不对称风险与收益特征

核心策略差异：备兑看涨期权是一种收益增强策略 (Income-generation)，通过放弃上方收益潜力换取前期的现金期权费。而保护性看跌期权则是一种资本保全策略 (Capital preservation)，通过前期支付现金成本来彻底消除灾难性的尾部下行风险。

分析维度 备兑看涨期权 (S0−c) 保护性看跌期权 (S0+p)
首要目标 获取权利金收益；在盘整市场中增强回报 防范市场崩盘风险；保全资本
期初现金流 现金净流入 (+) 来自卖出看涨期权 现金净流出 (−) 用于买入看跌期权
最大利润 封顶上限：K−S0+c 无限盈利：ST−(S0+p)
最大亏损 实质性下行风险：S0−c (若股价跌至 $0) 严格锁定上限：S0+p−K
盈亏平衡点 下移至：S0−c 上移至：S0+p
合成头寸等价性 经济实质等同于卖出看跌期权 (Short Put)：−p+Ke−rT 经济实质等同于买入看涨期权 (Long Call)：c+Ke−rT
根据买卖权平价定理公式 S0−c=−p+Ke−rT，卖出备兑看涨期权的投资者所承担的经济风险剖面与单纯卖出看跌期权完全一致：有限的上方收益与几乎全部的下行暴跌风险。
Page 10 · Protective PutsSlide ↗

Covered Call vs Protective Put: Asymmetric Risk & Profit Profiles

Strategic Distinction: The covered call is an income-generation strategy that surrenders upside for upfront cash yield. The protective put is a capital preservation strategy that pays cash upfront to eliminate catastrophic tail risk.

Dimension Covered Call (S0−c) Protective Put (S0+p)
Primary Objective Generate yield; enhance returns in stagnant market Insure against market crashes; preserve capital
Upfront Cash Flow Cash Inflow (+) from writing the call Cash Outflow (−) to buy the put
Maximum Profit Capped at: K−S0+c Unlimited: ST−(S0+p)
Maximum Loss Substantial downside: S0−c (if stock goes to $0) Strictly Capped at: S0+p−K
Breakeven Point Lowered to: S0−c Raised to: S0+p
Synthetic Identity Behaves like a Short Put: −p+Ke−rT Behaves like a Long Call: c+Ke−rT
Bionic Turtle Because put-call parity enforces S0−c=−p+Ke−rT, an investor writing a covered call assumes the exact same economic risk profile as a short put seller: limited upside and full downside exposure.
第 11 页 · 牛市与熊市差价幻灯片 ↗

差价策略 (Spreads)

  • 定义：差价策略是指在同一种标的资产上，同时持有两种或两种以上同类型期权（即两只或多只看涨期权，或两只或多只看跌期权）的组合头寸。
  • 主要差价策略分类：
    • 牛市差价 (Bull spreads)：
      • 利用看涨期权构建的牛市差价 (借方差价 Debit Spread)
      • 利用看跌期权构建的牛市差价 (贷方差价 Credit Spread)
    • 熊市差价 (Bear spreads)：
      • 利用看涨期权构建的熊市差价 (贷方差价 Credit Spread)
      • 利用看跌期权构建的熊市差价 (借方差价 Debit Spread)
    • 蝶式差价 (Butterfly spreads)：
      • 利用看涨期权构建的蝶式差价
      • 利用看跌期权构建的蝶式差价
    • 日历差价 (Calendar spreads)：
      • 相同行权价，不同到期日
Page 11 · Bull & Bear SpreadsSlide ↗

Spreads

  • Definition: A spread is a position in two or more options of the same type (i.e., two or more calls, or two or more puts) on the same underlying asset.
  • Major Types of Spreads:
    • Bull spreads:
      • Bull spread using calls (debit spread)
      • Bull spread using puts (credit spread)
    • Bear spreads:
      • Bear spread using calls (credit spread)
      • Bear spread using puts (debit spread)
    • Butterfly spreads:
      • Butterfly spread using calls
      • Butterfly spread using puts
    • Calendar spreads:
      • Same strike, different maturities
第 12 页 · 牛市与熊市差价幻灯片 ↗

利用看涨期权的牛市差价策略

  • 头寸构成：买入较低行权价 K1 的看涨期权，同时卖出较高行权价 K2 的看涨期权 (K1<K2)。
  • 适用市场环境：温和看涨 / 中度乐观的市场预期。
  • 策略优势：
    • 同时锁定了最大下行风险与最大上涨盈利。
    • 期初建仓成本较低；相比直接买入看涨期权更为便宜，因为卖出高行权价看涨期权所得的权利金补贴了买入期权的支出。
  • 策略特性：
    • 买入的看涨期权 (K1) 通常处于实值 (ITM) 或平值 (ATM)（较为昂贵）。
    • 卖出的看涨期权 (K2) 通常处于虚值 (OTM)（较为便宜）。
    • 当两只看涨期权均为虚值时，构成最进取型的牛市差价策略。
  • 面临问题：建仓需要净支付现金期权费（借方差价 Debit Spread）。
Page 12 · Bull & Bear SpreadsSlide ↗

Bull Spreads using Calls

  • Position: Long call with low strike K1 and short call with high strike K2 (K1<K2).
  • Market profile: Mildly bullish / moderately optimistic view.
  • Benefits:
    • Limits both downside risk and upside reward.
    • Low setup cost strategy; cheaper than buying a call outright because the short call premium subsidizes the long call.
  • Properties:
    • Long call (K1) is typically ITM/ATM (expensive).
    • Short call (K2) is typically OTM (cheaper).
    • Most aggressive bull spread occurs when both calls are OTM.
  • Problem: Requires an upfront net cash premium (debit spread).
第 13 页 · 牛市与熊市差价幻灯片 ↗

利用看跌期权的牛市差价策略

  • 头寸构成：买入较低行权价 K1 的看跌期权，同时卖出较高行权价 K2 的看跌期权 (K1<K2)。
  • 短期收益增强策略：
    • 期初带来正向现金净流入（贷方差价 Credit Spread）。
    • 卖出较高行权价看跌期权收取的期权费，高于买入较低行权价看跌期权的支出 (p2>p1)。
  • 保证金要求：
    • 由于包含较高行权价的看跌期权空头，交易所会要求缴纳保证金以确保履行履约担保义务。
Page 13 · Bull & Bear SpreadsSlide ↗

Bull Spreads using Puts

  • Position: Long put with low strike K1 and short put with high strike K2 (K1<K2).
  • Short-term income strategy:
    • Provides an upfront positive cash flow (credit spread).
    • Selling the higher-strike put generates more premium than the cost of buying the lower-strike put (p2>p1).
  • Margin requirements:
    • Because it involves a short put with high strike, it attracts exchange margin requirements to guarantee performance.
第 14 页 · 牛市与熊市差价幻灯片 ↗

牛市差价：看涨借方差价 vs 看跌贷方差价

简单市场数据（S0=$100，利率 0，同一到期日）：看涨期权：K=90 (c=$12)，K=110 (c=$3) • 看跌期权：K=90 (p=$2)，K=110 (p=$13)。
差价策略类型 期权腿构成 期初净现金流 最大利润 最大亏损 盈亏平衡点
看涨牛市差价
(借方差价) 		买入看涨 (90) −$12
卖出看涨 (110) +$3 		−$9
(现金流出) 		+$11
(110−90)−9 		−$9
(期初支出) 		90+9=$99
看跌牛市差价
(贷方差价) 		买入看跌 (90) −$2
卖出看跌 (110) +$13 		+$11
(现金流入) 		+$11
(保留权利金) 		−$9
(110−90)−11 		110−11=$99
  • 为什么两者损益一模一样？利率为 0 时买卖权平价定理简化为 c+K=p+S0（检验：12+90=2+100，3+110=13+100），所以两种构建在每个 ST 下净利润完全相同（平衡点同为 $99，盈亏同为 +$11 / −$9）；区别只在期初现金流方向与保证金。
  • 箱式差价联结 (Box Spread)：买入看涨牛市差价（付 $9）+ 买入看跌熊市差价（买 K=110 看跌、卖 K=90 看跌，付 13−2=$11）构成箱式差价 (Box spread)：期初共付 9+11=$20，到期无论股价如何必定收回 K2−K1=$20。利率为 0 时 $20 就是公道价格（若利率为正，应为 $20 的现值）；一旦偏离即可套利。
  • 课本原题（ETQ 12，S0=$30 的市场数据）完整解答见《Hull 习题与解答》第 6 讲。
Page 14 · Bull & Bear SpreadsSlide ↗

Bull Spreads: Call Debit Spread vs Put Credit Spread

Simple market data (S0=$100, rate 0, same maturity): Calls: K=90 (c=$12), K=110 (c=$3) • Puts: K=90 (p=$2), K=110 (p=$13).
Spread Type Option Legs Initial Cash Flow Max Profit Max Loss Breakeven
Bull Call Spread
(Debit Spread) 		Long Call (90) −$12
Short Call (110) +$3 		−$9
(Cash outflow) 		+$11
(110−90)−9 		−$9
(Initial debit) 		90+9=$99
Bull Put Spread
(Credit Spread) 		Long Put (90) −$2
Short Put (110) +$13 		+$11
(Cash inflow) 		+$11
(Keep the credit) 		−$9
(110−90)−11 		110−11=$99
  • Why identical P/L? At rate 0, put-call parity is c+K=p+S0 (check: 12+90=2+100, 3+110=13+100), so both give the same profit at every ST (breakeven $99, P/L +$11 / −$9); only the cash-flow direction and margin differ.
  • Box Spread Connection: Long call bull spread (pay $9) + long put bear spread (buy K=110 put, sell K=90 put, pay 13−2=$11) = box spread: pay 9+11=$20 now, always receive K2−K1=$20 at maturity. At rate 0, $20 is fair (else the PV of $20); any deviation allows arbitrage.
  • Original Hull problem (ETQ 12, S0=$30 data) with full solution: see Hull Exercises & Solutions, Lecture 6.
第 15 页 · 牛市与熊市差价幻灯片 ↗

利用看跌期权的熊市差价策略

  • 头寸构成：买入较高行权价 K2 的看跌期权，同时卖出较低行权价 K1 的看跌期权 (K1<K2)。
  • 适用市场环境：温和看跌 / 中度悲观的市场预期。
  • 策略优势：
    • 同时锁定了最大下行收益与最大上行亏损。
    • 期初建仓成本较低；比直接买入看跌期权更便宜，因为卖出看跌期权的权利金抵消了部分买入成本。
  • 策略特性：
    • 买入的看跌期权 (K2) 通常处于实值 (ITM)（较为昂贵）。
    • 卖出的看跌期权 (K1) 通常处于虚值 (OTM)（较为便宜）。
  • 面临问题：需要期初净支付权利金（借方差价 Debit Spread）。
Page 15 · Bull & Bear SpreadsSlide ↗

Bear Spreads using Puts

  • Position: Long put with high strike K2 and short put with low strike K1 (K1<K2).
  • Market profile: Mildly bearish / moderately pessimistic view.
  • Benefits:
    • Limits both downside and upside risk.
    • Low setup cost strategy; cheaper than buying a put outright because short put premium offsets long put expense.
  • Properties:
    • Long put (K2) is typically ITM (expensive).
    • Short put (K1) is typically OTM (cheaper).
  • Problem: Requires an upfront net premium (debit spread).
第 16 页 · 牛市与熊市差价幻灯片 ↗

利用看涨期权的熊市差价策略

  • 头寸构成：买入较高行权价 K2 的看涨期权，同时卖出较低行权价 K1 的看涨期权 (K1<K2)。
  • 短期收益增强策略：
    • 期初带来正向现金净流入（贷方差价 Credit Spread）。
    • 卖出较低行权价看涨期权 (K1) 收取的期权费，高于买入较高行权价看涨期权 (K2) 的支出。
  • 保证金要求：
    • 交易所要求缴纳保证金，以应对看涨期权空头腿在标的资产大幅上涨时可能面临的履约义务。
Page 16 · Bull & Bear SpreadsSlide ↗

Bear Spreads using Calls

  • Position: Long call with high strike K2 and short call with low strike K1 (K1<K2).
  • Short-term income strategy:
    • Provides an upfront positive cash flow (credit spread).
    • Selling the lower-strike call (K1) generates more premium than the cost of buying the higher-strike call (K2).
  • Margin requirements:
    • Attracts exchange margin requirements to cover potential obligations on the short call leg.
第 17 页 · 蝶式差价幻灯片 ↗

利用看涨期权的蝶式差价策略

  • 构建方法：买入1份较低行权价 K1 的看涨期权，买入1份较高行权价 K3 的看涨期权，同时卖出2份中间行权价 K2 的看涨期权：
    K2=K1+K32
  • 适用市场环境：平稳 / 低波动率预期；预计标的股票价格将在到期时维持在中间行权价 K2 附近。
  • 优势与局限：建仓成本低且盈利目标明确；但需要期初支付净权利金。
  • 反向蝶式差价 (Reverse Butterfly)：卖出 K1、卖出 K3、买入2份 K2 → 适合预期市场将发生剧烈波动的情形。
Page 17 · Butterfly SpreadsSlide ↗

Butterfly Spreads using Calls

  • Construction: Long one call with low strike K1, long one call with high strike K3, and short two calls with middle strike K2:
    K2=K1+K32
  • Market profile: Stable / low volatility outlook; expects stock to remain near K2.
  • Benefits & Problem: Low setup cost with modest profit; requires upfront net premium.
  • Reverse Butterfly: Short K1, short K3, long two K2 → profitable in high volatility.
第 18 页 · 蝶式差价幻灯片 ↗

案例：利用看涨期权的蝶式差价策略

设定：投资者预期某股票 (S0=$100) 在到期前走势平稳。市场上有三只同一到期日的看涨期权：
K1=$90,c1=$12；K2=$100,c2=$5；K3=$110,c3=$3
头寸构成：买入1份 Call (90)，卖出2份 Call (100)，买入1份 Call (110)。建仓成本：−12+2×5−3=−$5。
到期价格 ST 买入 (90) 卖出2份 (100) 买入 (110) 回报合计 净损益
$80 0 0 0 0 −5
$90 0 0 0 0 −5
$100 ★ 100−90=+10 0 0 +10 +5（最大盈利）
$110 +20 −2×10=−20 0 0 −5
$120 +30 −2×20=−40 120−110=+10 0 −5
净损益 = 到期回报合计 − 建仓成本 $5（利率 0，直接按到期计算）。
Page 18 · Butterfly SpreadsSlide ↗

Example: Butterfly Spread using Calls

Setup: An investor expects the stock (S0=$100) to trade sideways until maturity. Three calls with the same maturity are available:
K1=$90,c1=$12; K2=$100,c2=$5; K3=$110,c3=$3
Position: Long one Call (90), Short two Calls (100), Long one Call (110). Setup cost: −12+2×5−3=−$5.
Terminal Price ST Long Call (90) Short 2 Calls (100) Long Call (110) Total Payoff Net P/L
$80 0 0 0 0 −5
$90 0 0 0 0 −5
$100 ★ 100−90=+10 0 0 +10 +5 (Max Profit)
$110 +20 −2×10=−20 0 0 −5
$120 +30 −2×20=−40 120−110=+10 0 −5
Net P/L = total payoff at maturity − $5 setup cost (rate 0, computed directly at maturity).
第 19 页 · 蝶式差价幻灯片 ↗

案例分析 – 蝶式差价策略评估

  • 盈亏平衡点：ST=90+5=$95 与 ST=110−5=$105。
  • 最大利润：当 ST=$100（中间行权价）时取得最大利润 10−5=+$5。
  • 最大亏损：当 ST≤90 或 ST≥110 时，亏损锁定为期初净权利金支出 −$5。
  • 盈利价格区间：当 $95<ST<$105 时该策略实现净盈利。
  • 利用看跌期权的蝶式差价：买入看跌 K1、卖出2份看跌 K2、买入看跌 K3 会产生完全一致的损益图。
Page 19 · Butterfly SpreadsSlide ↗

Example – Butterfly Spread Analysis

  • Breakeven points: ST=90+5=$95 and ST=110−5=$105.
  • Maximum profit: At ST=$100 (middle strike): 10−5=+$5.
  • Maximum loss: For ST≤90 or ST≥110, the loss is locked at the net premium −$5.
  • Profitable range: Net profit when $95<ST<$105.
  • Butterfly using Puts: Long put K1, short two puts K2, long put K3 gives an identical P/L diagram.
第 20 页 · 日历差价幻灯片 ↗

日历差价策略 (Calendar Spread)

  • 核心概念：利用相同行权价 K 但不同到期日的期权构建组合。
  • 利用看涨期权的日历差价：
    • 卖出近期看涨期权，同时买入远期看涨期权。
    • 利用了近期期权时间价值衰减速度快于远期期权（近期期权具有更高的 heta 绝对值）的特性。
    • 若在近期期权到期时，股票价格接近行权价 K，近期期权将毫无价值地作废，而远期期权依然保留着可观的时间价值。
  • 利用看跌期权的日历差价：
    • 卖出近期看跌期权，同时买入远期看跌期权。
  • 反向日历差价 (Reverse Calendar Spread)：
    • 买入近期期权并卖出远期期权；当股票价格发生剧烈单向大幅突破时获利。
Page 20 · Calendar SpreadsSlide ↗

Calendar Spread

  • Core Concept: Use options with the same strike price K but different expiration dates.
  • Calendar spread using Calls:
    • Sell a short-dated call option and buy a longer-dated call option.
    • Capitalizes on the fact that the short-dated option decays faster (higher θ) than the long-dated option.
    • If the stock price remains close to strike K when the short option expires, the short option expires worthless while the long-dated option retains substantial time value.
  • Calendar spread using Puts:
    • Sell a short-dated put option and buy a longer-dated put option.
  • Reverse Calendar Spread:
    • Buy a short-dated option and sell a longer-dated option; profitable when stock makes large directional moves.
第 21 页 · 跨式期权幻灯片 ↗

组合策略 (Combinations)

  • 定义：组合策略是指将同一种标的资产上的看涨期权与看跌期权混合构建的交易策略。
  • 主要类别：
    • 跨式期权 (Straddles)：相同的行权价与相同的到期日。
    • 条式与带式组合 (Strips and Straps)：看涨期权与看跌期权比例不对称的组合。
    • 宽跨式期权 (Strangles)：不同的行权价与相同的到期日。
  • 组合策略的本质 – 纯波动率交易：
    • 做多波动率策略 (Long volatility)：当标的资产在任一方向出现大幅价格跳跃变动时盈利（具有正的 Vega 值）。
    • 做空波动率策略 (Short volatility)：当标的资产价格平稳盘整、窄幅震荡时盈利（具有正的 Theta 值，赚取时间价值衰减）。
Page 21 · StraddlesSlide ↗

Combinations

  • Definition: Combinations are trading strategies that involve mixtures of calls and puts on the same underlying asset.
  • Primary Categories:
    • Straddles: Same strike and same maturity.
    • Strips and Straps: Asymmetric combinations of calls and puts.
    • Strangles: Different strikes and same maturity.
  • Nature of Combinations – Pure Volatility Trades:
    • Long volatility strategies: Profit when the underlying asset experiences large price swings in either direction (positive Vega).
    • Short volatility strategies: Profit when the underlying asset remains quiet and range-bound (positive Theta, earning time decay).
第 22 页 · 跨式期权幻灯片 ↗

跨式期权 (Straddles)

  • 底部跨式 / 买入跨式 (Bottom Straddle / Long Straddle)：
    • 买入1份看涨期权和1份看跌期权，两者具有相同行权价 K 与相同到期日 T。
    • 做多波动率策略：若价格向任意方向发生大幅跳跃，即可享受无限盈利潜力。
    • 最大可能亏损严格锁定为所支付的全部权利金合计 (c+p)。
  • 顶部跨式 / 卖出跨式 (Top Straddle / Short Straddle)：
    • 卖出1份看涨期权和1份看跌期权，两者具有相同的行权价 K 与到期日 T。
    • 做空波动率策略：在低波动率、波澜不惊的市场中赚取期权权利金收入。
    • 风险极高：若股价向任一方向发生剧烈波动，都将面临无限亏损的敞口。
Page 22 · StraddlesSlide ↗

Straddles

  • Bottom Straddle (Straddle Purchase / Long Straddle):
    • Buy 1 call and 1 put with the same strike K and same maturity T.
    • Long Volatility strategy: Unlimited profit potential if a major price jump occurs in either direction.
    • Limited maximum loss capped at total premium paid (c+p).
  • Top Straddle (Straddle Write / Short Straddle):
    • Sell 1 call and 1 put with the same strike K and maturity T.
    • Short Volatility strategy: Earn premium income in low volatility, stagnant markets.
    • Highly risky: Unlimited loss potential from large price movements in either direction.
第 23 页 · 跨式期权幻灯片 ↗

买入 vs 卖出跨式期权：波动率机制与双重盈亏平衡点

CME 权威定义：“脚踏两只船 (Straddling the fence)” — 同时押注双向。当交易者预期价格即将发生颠覆性突破但无法确定具体突破方向时（例如在财报公布前、重大监管审批揭晓或 CPI 通胀数据发布前），买入跨式期权是标准操作。

买入跨式期权 (买入看涨 + 买入看跌)
  • 总成本：V0=c+p（最大亏损发生在 ST=K 时）。
  • 上方盈亏平衡点：K+(c+p)
  • 下方盈亏平衡点：K−(c+p)
  • 希腊字母特征：显著的正 Vega (V>0) 与正 Gamma (Γ>0)；承受负 Theta (Θ<0) 时间价值侵蚀。
卖出跨式期权 (卖出看涨 + 卖出看跌)
  • 最大利润：c+p（在市场收盘恰好等于行权价 K 时获得）。
  • 盈亏平衡点：完全相同（K±(c+p)）。
  • 风险特征：若标的股票向任意一侧发生大幅跳跃并穿透平衡点，亏损潜力无限。
  • 希腊字母特征：正 Theta (Θ>0，赚取时间价值衰减) 与负 Vega (V<0)。
简单例子：K=$100，看涨、看跌期权费各 $5，总成本 c+p=$10。盈亏平衡点：100+10=$110 与 100−10=$90 —— 股价涨破 $110 或跌破 $90 才开始盈利；股价恰好收在 $100 时亏掉全部 $10。
Page 23 · StraddlesSlide ↗

Long vs Short Straddles: Volatility Mechanics & Dual Breakevens

CME Definition: “Straddling the fence” — betting on both sides at once. A long straddle is the standard trade when a big breakout is expected but the direction is unknown (e.g. before earnings, regulatory approvals, or CPI data).

Long Straddle (Buy Call + Buy Put)
  • Total Cost: V0=c+p (max loss at ST=K).
  • Upper Breakeven: K+(c+p)
  • Lower Breakeven: K−(c+p)
  • Greeks: Large positive Vega (V>0) and Gamma (Γ>0); negative Theta (Θ<0) time decay.
Short Straddle (Sell Call + Sell Put)
  • Max Profit: c+p (if the market closes exactly at K).
  • Breakevens: Identical (K±(c+p)).
  • Risk Profile: Unlimited loss if the stock jumps through either breakeven.
  • Greeks: Positive Theta (Θ>0, earns decay), negative Vega (V<0).
Simple Example: K=$100, call and put $5 each, so c+p=$10. Breakevens: 100+10=$110 and 100−10=$90 — profit starts only above $110 or below $90; at exactly $100 the full $10 is lost.
第 24 页 · 条式与带式组合幻灯片 ↗

条式组合与带式组合 (Strips and Straps)

  • 买入条式组合 (Long Strip)：
    • 买入1份看涨期权和2份看跌期权，均具有相同的行权价 K 与到期日 T。
    • 适用市场预期：预期波动率剧烈增大，且带有偏空头倾向（下行斜率的陡峭程度是上行斜率的两倍）。
  • 买入带式组合 (Long Strap)：
    • 买入2份看涨期权和1份看跌期权，均具有相同的行权价 K 与到期日 T。
    • 适用市场预期：预期波动率剧烈增大，且带有偏多头倾向（上行斜率的陡峭程度是下行斜率的两倍）。
Page 24 · Strips & StrapsSlide ↗

Strips and Straps

  • Long Strip:
    • Buy 1 call and 2 puts with the same strike K and maturity T.
    • Market profile: High volatility expected, with a bearish bias (downside slope is twice as steep as upside).
  • Long Strap:
    • Buy 2 calls and 1 put with the same strike K and maturity T.
    • Market profile: High volatility expected, with a bullish bias (upside slope is twice as steep as downside).
第 25 页 · 宽跨式与策略比较幻灯片 ↗

宽跨式期权 (Strangles)

  • 底部垂直组合 / 买入宽跨式 (Bottom Vertical Combination / Long Strangle)：
    • 买入相同到期日但不同行权价的看涨期权与看跌期权：买入较低行权价 K1 的看跌期权，并买入较高行权价 K2 的看涨期权 (K1<K2)。
    • 做多波动率策略：建仓成本比跨式期权更便宜，因为两只期权通常均为虚值期权 (OTM)。
    • 权衡取舍：股价必须发生比跨式期权更大幅度的偏离波动，策略方能开始实现盈利。
  • 顶部垂直组合 / 卖出宽跨式 (Top Vertical Combination / Short Strangle)：
    • 卖出不同行权价 (K1<K2) 且相同到期日的看涨期权与看跌期权。
    • 做空波动率策略；在 K1 与 K2 之间提供了一个更宽阔的安全无损盈利带。
Page 25 · Strangles & ComparisonSlide ↗

Strangles

  • Bottom Vertical Combination (Strangle Purchase / Long Strangle):
    • Long a call and a put with different strikes and the same maturity: Long put with low strike K1 and long call with high strike K2 (K1<K2).
    • Long volatility strategy: Cheaper to buy than a straddle because both options are typically OTM.
    • Trade-off: The stock price must move further than in a straddle to generate profits.
  • Top Vertical Combination (Strangle Write / Short Strangle):
    • Short a call and a put with different strikes (K1<K2) and same maturity.
    • Short volatility strategy; provides a wider safety band between K1 and K2.
第 26 页 · 宽跨式与策略比较幻灯片 ↗

买入宽跨式：分段损益表与双重盈亏平衡点

简单例子：股票 S0=$100。买入虚值看跌期权 K1=$90 (p=$2) + 买入虚值看涨期权 K2=$110 (c=$3)。
期初总成本（最大亏损）：2+3=$5。
到期价格 (ST) 到期总回报 期权费成本 净损益 策略表现 / 盈亏平衡
ST≤90 (大跌) 90−ST −$5 85−ST 盈亏平衡点：ST=$85
90<ST<110 (盘整) 0 −$5 −$5 (最大亏损) 两只期权均无价值归零作废
ST≥110 (大涨) ST−110 −$5 ST−115 盈亏平衡点：ST=$115
双重盈亏平衡点分析：
下方平衡点：90−5=$85（股价需跌超 15%）
上方平衡点：110+5=$115（股价需涨超 15%）

与平值跨式期权 (K=100) 对比：跨式组合总成本为 5+5=$10，盈亏平衡点为 $90 与 $110（股价只需波动 10%）。宽跨式便宜一半（$5 vs $10），但需要股价波动超过 15% 才能扭亏为盈。课本原题（ETQ 11）完整解答见《Hull 习题与解答》第 6 讲。

Page 26 · Strangles & ComparisonSlide ↗

Long Strangle: Piecewise Profit Table & Dual Breakevens

Simple Example: Stock S0=$100. Buy an OTM put K1=$90 (p=$2) + buy an OTM call K2=$110 (c=$3).
Total Upfront Cost (Maximum Loss): 2+3=$5.
Terminal Price (ST) Total Payoff Premium Cost Net P/L Outcome / Breakeven
ST≤90 (Plunge) 90−ST −$5 85−ST Breakeven at ST=$85
90<ST<110 (Flat) 0 −$5 −$5 (Max Loss) Both options expire worthless
ST≥110 (Surge) ST−110 −$5 ST−115 Breakeven at ST=$115
Dual Breakeven Analysis:
Lower Breakeven: 90−5=$85 (stock must fall more than 15%)
Upper Breakeven: 110+5=$115 (stock must rise more than 15%)

Comparison with the ATM straddle (K=100): The straddle costs 5+5=$10 in total, with breakevens at $90 and $110 (the stock only needs to move 10%). The strangle is half the price ($5 vs $10), but needs a move of more than 15% to turn profitable. Original Hull problem (ETQ 11) with full solution: see Hull Exercises & Solutions, Lecture 6.

第 27 页 · 宽跨式与策略比较幻灯片 ↗

做空波动率策略对比

跨式、宽跨式、蝶式差价与鹰式差价
Page 27 · Strangles & ComparisonSlide ↗

Comparison of Short Volatility Strategies

Straddle, Strangle, Butterfly, and Condor
第 28 页 · 宽跨式与策略比较幻灯片 ↗

做空波动率策略对比

  • 跨式期权 (Straddle)：提供最高潜在回报，利润在股价恰好收在行权价时见顶，但在两侧均承担无限亏损风险。
  • 宽跨式期权 (Strangle)：在两个行权价之间提供扁平的最大回报区间，但两侧同样面临无限亏损风险。
  • 蝶式差价 (Butterfly)：具有类似跨式期权的尖峰回报形态；然而，由于买入了外侧虚值“翅膀”期权以锁定最大亏损，其最大利润有所削减。蝶式差价本质上是对跨式期权进行了风险管理的改良版本。
  • 鹰式差价 (Condor)：呈现两侧风险被严格锁定的扁平最大收益区；其最大利润在四者中最小。鹰式差价本质上是对宽跨式期权进行了风险管理的改良版本。
  • 资金实力与风险管理：
    • 蝶式差价对于资金规模较小、无法承受裸卖空跨式或宽跨式无限尾部风险的交易者而言，是非常卓越的交易策略。
    • 裸卖空跨式与宽跨式期权仅适合具备雄厚资本实力、能够从容承受剧烈不利波动的专业机构投资者。
Page 28 · Strangles & ComparisonSlide ↗

Comparison of Short Volatility Strategies

  • Straddle: Highest potential return, peaking when the stock closes exactly at the strike, but unlimited loss risk on both sides.
  • Strangle: Flat maximum return between the two strikes, but likewise unlimited loss risk on both sides.
  • Butterfly: Peaked return like the straddle, but maximum profit is reduced by buying OTM “wings” to cap the loss. Essentially a risk-managed modification of the straddle.
  • Condor: Flat maximum-return zone with strictly capped risk on both sides; smallest maximum profit of the four. Essentially a risk-managed modification of the strangle.
  • Capital Strength & Risk Management:
    • The butterfly is an excellent strategy for under-capitalized traders who cannot bear the unlimited tail risk of naked straddles or strangles.
    • Naked straddles and strangles suit only well-capitalized professionals able to withstand sharp adverse moves.
